reason: A text-processing plugin that formats JSON, YAML, TOML, and SQL, validates structured formats, and reports parsing locations when available.

summaries.zh: 用于格式化和校验 JSON、YAML、TOML 与 SQL 文本，并在可用时返回错误行列位置。
summaries.en: Formats and validates JSON, YAML, TOML, and SQL text, returning error line and column locations when available.

capabilities: Formats JSON, YAML, TOML, and SQL text
Validates JSON, YAML, and TOML input
Returns formatting or parsing errors with line and column locations when available
